ITEM.PTXT: The front area uses a "character line" that flows vertically from the hood panel and spreads horizontally at the bottom of the front bumper, emphasizing the three-dimensional center and expressing a sporty and wide feel.
Functional parts such as the deep bumper opening, radiator grille and headlights are arranged as if carved in, giving a powerful design befitting the power performance.

In the side area, a dynamic side silhouette has been achieved through front and rear fender shapes that assert driving performance, a forward-sloping belt line, and swelling of the hood panel and back door.
The front fenders are integrally shaped with the body, and door outside mouldings with a geometric pattern accentuate the sporty feel.
Side mudguards are provided on grades other than the standard grade, and the lower portion bulges outward, giving a stable, low center of gravity body.
A grade mark has been provided on the right side of the back door on 2GR-FE engine models.
The radiator grille of 2GR-FE engine models has a precise mesh shape (dark gray metallic), and the outer frame is chrome-plated to create a sense of luxury.
On models with a millimeter wave radar sensor assembly, a millimeter wave transmissive grille cover has been provided at the emblem.
Only models w/ pre-crash safety system + radar cruise control system
Cover that transmits the radar waves emitted from the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly

With "DEEP IMPACT" as the color design concept, a total of 7 colors combining "a calm, mature feel and youthful dynamism" have been provided, including "Deep Gold Pearl Crystal Shine", whose body color changes with shading.
The following exterior parts are in the same color as the body color, enhancing color coordination.

Interlayer anti-chipping paint has been applied to the rocker area of standard grades, and rocker protectors have been provided at the bottom of the rockers to prevent damage to the body due to chipping while driving.

Anti-chipping tape has been provided on the rear of the rear doors, the quarter panels, etc. of cold area specification models for excellent paint film protection and rust prevention against gravel and frozen snow thrown up by the tires. The anti-chipping painted area has a different finish texture (orange peel) from normal painted areas.
Small stones, sand, etc. thrown up mainly by the front wheels hitting the vehicle body while driving.
The painted surface becoming grainy and rough.
The following parts of the body have been blacked out for a tight design.

Recyclability has been improved by adopting Toyota Super Olefin Polymer (TSOP), a highly recyclable material, and PVC-free material (TPO) for the roof mouldings, belt mouldings, etc. In addition, the silicone applied to the door weatherstrips has been changed from an organic material to an inorganic material in consideration of the environment.
